title: openclaw 2026.11.5-beta.2
summary:
2026.11.5-beta.2

Highlights

  • Large conversations remain browsable with paged history in both directions, visible history boundaries, and bounded archive reads. (#188450 #188483 #188557 #188372 #190690) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @xydt-tanshanshan.
  • The macOS app preserves saved secrets and Gateway authentication when configuration saves fail or Tailscale exposure is turned off. (#187734 #187664; related #187600, #187597) Thanks @anmol0b.
  • Ending Talk on Android no longer cancels work the Gateway has already accepted. (#188798; related #188134) Thanks @RomneyDa and @jeffjhunter.

Changes

  • Google: use the Interactions API for Gemini Flash models on the official endpoint while retaining custom endpoint overrides. (#189395) Thanks @obviyus.

Fixes

  • Security: reject malformed URI identifiers using fast-uri 4.2.3 while preserving valid relative references. (#187284) Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.

  • Security: reject oversized bounded collections early in the Discord SDK and its transitive Zod 3 parser without restoring the retired A2UI integration. (#187296 #187303) Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.

  • Message delivery: acknowledge retried committed input without starting duplicate turns, retain queued messages during inline edits, and keep Control UI plugin-reload replies from leaking into the last external chat. (#188527 #189869 #190982; related #189845, #190980) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @shakkernerd, and @Satoshi-Kusumoto.

  • Chat recovery: preserve completed reasoning, refill chat snapshots, retain active-request provenance through compaction, and resume configured fallbacks after interrupted attempts. (#188203 #180214 #188672; related #188181) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @shakkernerd and @RomneyDa.

  • Sessions: bound listing, imported-history, and accounting reads without blocking writers; omit misleading continuation metadata from centered history. (#189284 #190182 #188612) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.

  • PostgreSQL: keep session search on its text index across repeated searches, use a safe iMessage recovery cursor, and allow Boards widgets to publish. (#187909 #188979 #184919 #189564; related #187908, #188954, #184862) Thanks @etzelm, @obviyus, and @galiniliev.

  • Files: preserve the identity of Unicode keys when reading and editing workspace paths. (#189868; related #189866) Thanks @Malpin07 and @obviyus.

  • File transfer: avoid first-turn workspace-memory and skills import races when plugins load from TypeScript source. (#191838) Thanks @RomneyDa.

  • Agents: keep subagent turns and model fallback aligned with changed session capabilities, and surface child approval requests to parents using custom session stores. (#179312 #183501 #189827; related #179290, #189823) Thanks @chelsealong, @obviyus, @Marvinthebored, @RomneyDa, and @ekinnee.

  • Tool outcomes: retain timeout results so interrupted tools are not mistaken for confirmed failures without side effects. (#180247) Thanks @RomneyDa.

  • Matrix: start new thread sessions without copying the room transcript; report readiness only after startup, let stopped CLI clients exit, and report late verification failures rather than crashing. (#177272 #192385; related #176224) Thanks @Linux2010, @obviyus, @seriouslysean, and @RomneyDa.

  • Google: honor configured topP and restore tool calls whose parameter names are Python keywords. (#190695 #191561; related #190468) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Yigtwxx, @obviyus, @yetval, and @HighervGround.

  • Anthropic: keep setup-token credentials separate from API-key profiles, set the API workspace at login, and allow reasoning-only retries. (#187875 #186976 #184434; related #187868, #187018, #182178) Thanks @RomneyDa, @sasan1200, @sukhdeepjohar, and @goslingmanagment.

  • Models: keep healthy providers available when another provider lacks credentials or its catalog hook fails, and scope discovery warnings to the affected provider. (#189014 #189059 #188541) Thanks @obviyus.

  • Codex: preserve conversation guidance; resolve native follow-ups by task name, wait for previous thread owners to unload, and preserve one-shot cleanup. (#189005 #191830; related #188929) Thanks @lastguru-net, @beru-ant-king, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.

  • macOS connections: resolve typed authentication references, prefer configured credentials over stale app environment values, and replace stale Gateway services safely after in-place updates. (#128175 #191468 #187000; related #128171) Thanks @TheAngryPit, @CassieMei, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, and @anmol0b.

  • macOS tools and UI: show load failures instead of blank or stale browser pages, avoid duplicate voice sends and false sent feedback, preserve no-timeout execution results, and use the correct Peekaboo observation references. (#185432 #186271 #190729 #172116) Thanks @etzelm, @RomneyDa, @anmol0b, @holgergruenhagen, and @LiuwqGit.

  • Settings: support remote Control UI base paths and open GitHub reconnection from the active session. (#185141 #180200; related #164596) Thanks @RomneyDa, @anmol0b, and @goldmar.

  • Updates: recover cleanly from failed upgrades out of 2026.10.7–2026.10.9, preserve recovery errors and asynchronous triage callbacks, avoid first-launch Gateway failures, and read candidate state without copying the shared database. (#189713 #191495 #191436 #187921 #189023) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @PollyBot13.

  • Plugins: run continuing native commands once, respect disabled mixed-case plugin IDs, restore CLI message sends under agent tool policies, and avoid recopying managed binaries on startup. (#189369 #188846 #188058 #187865; related #189367, #188845) Thanks @nxmxbbd, @obviyus, @masatohoshino, @Marvinthebored, and @jasonftl.

  • Startup and shutdown: honor pending-channel webhook decisions, keep lease renewal independent of parent admission, and avoid reopening agent databases during shutdown. (#169778 #188391 #188976) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @htjworld and @vincentkoc.

  • Scheduling and startup diagnostics: run jobs added before scheduler startup without an extra deferral and flush startup evidence before declaring readiness. (#192379 #192383) Thanks @RomneyDa.

  • Storage: preserve cold-database admission and retry contended lease cleanup using the renewed lease expiry. (#192378) Thanks @RomneyDa.

  • Configuration: ignore empty default plugin entries rather than widening an explicitly restricted plugin allowlist. (#192380) Thanks @RomneyDa.

  • Process startup: preserve cleanup grace and report the original startup error ahead of cleanup failures while sharing inherited process lineage across module copies. (#192386) Thanks @RomneyDa.

  • Worktrees: settle completed disk usage accounting even when a postcheck refuses further work. (#188727) Authored by @steipete.

  • macOS service runtime ownership: prepare and retain the stable executable across install, resume, migration, and service restoration without replacing a newer runtime during failed settlement. Thanks @RomneyDa.

  • Release recovery: retain publication retry diagnostics and preserve the reconciled release repairs. (#189130 #191633) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa.

  • Release notes: retain original contribution provenance for work first merged on a release branch. (#193613) Thanks @RomneyDa.

This audited record covers the complete v2026.11.5-beta.1..d407001 history: 95 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 95 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.
